purpose: Route an AI agent from a reported Hermes behavior to the smallest frontend/backend ownership slice that can diagnose and fix it.
diagnosisOrder: Match the symptom to a feature label or alias.
Open frontend.entrypoints and backend.entrypoints before searching broadly.
Trace the listed API prefixes through frontend/src/api.ts and the owning controller.
Read supporting services and persistence only when the controller call chain reaches them.
Add or update the nearest listed tests, then run the feature verification commands.
For website or backend runtime claims, also run the runtime proof gates in AGENTS.md.

features.label: Authentication and account access
features.routingNotes: Use this branch for credential and provider access; admin dashboard behavior routes to admin-operations after authentication succeeds.

features.label: Runner profile and dashboard
features.routingNotes: Use profile for identity and dashboard state; subscription checkout or quota enforcement routes to billing-subscriptions.

features.label: Runs list and activity lifecycle
features.routingNotes: Use runs for already-ingested activity lifecycle; upload and normalization routes to activity-import, and reward effects route to rewards-cosmetics.

features.label: Run detail, telemetry, and elevation
features.routingNotes: Use this branch for one activity's detail payload and presentation; list, import, and reward side effects stay with their owning branches.

features.label: Analysis, insights, and predictions
features.routingNotes: Use analysis for derived insights and predictions; import failures on the shared analysis route belong to activity-import.
verify: cd frontend && npm run test:unit -- --run src/utils/predictionSelection.vitest.ts

features.label: Activity heatmap
features.routingNotes: Use heatmap for map data, cache, and rendering; activity list or reward behavior remains with activities-runs or rewards-cosmetics.

features.label: Today Run and automated coaching
features.routingNotes: Use this branch for the shared personalized plan consumed by Today Run, Profile, Schedule, and Coach Insight, not generic profile dashboard fields.
verify: cd frontend && npm.cmd exec vitest run src/utils/personalizedCoachPlan.vitest.js

features.label: Weather engine and fitness interpretation
features.routingNotes: Use weather for forecast and weather-adjusted interpretation, separating upstream provider failures from presentation.

features.label: Shoes, catalog, recommendations, and AI scan
features.routingNotes: Use this branch for shoe inventory, catalog, scan, and assignment; activity history remains with activities-runs or run-detail.

features.label: Races, elevation, and course maps
features.routingNotes: Use races for saved race and course-map behavior; admin publishing uses admin-operations as the control owner.

features.label: Schedule and route planning
features.routingNotes: Use schedule for planned workouts and route validity, distinct from completed activity telemetry.

features.label: Muscle training plans and check-ins
features.routingNotes: Use this branch for strength plans, sessions, and check-ins rather than run coaching recommendations.

features.label: Rewards, milestones, and digital cosmetics
features.routingNotes: Use rewards for post-activity reward calculation and inventory; activity retrieval and deletion remain with activities-runs.

features.label: Settings, identity, preferences, and avatar
features.routingNotes: Use settings for generic account preferences and avatar; provider linking or sync routes to integrations-sync.
contracts: client theme, unit, and locale contexts

features.label: Activity file import and normalization
features.routingNotes: Use import for upload, parser, and normalization even when entered from runs or analysis routes; existing activity lifecycle stays with activities-runs.

features.label: Strava, Garmin, and wellness integrations
features.routingNotes: Use integrations for provider credentials, linking, and sync; generic account settings remain with settings-account.

features.label: Billing, subscription tier, and AI quota
features.routingNotes: Use billing for checkout, subscription state, and quota; profile presentation without billing mutation remains with runner-profile.

features.label: Admin dashboard, users, jobs, shoes, and race maps
features.routingNotes: Use admin-operations for privileged management and publishing actions, regardless of the public surface displaying the result.

features.label: Shared API client, routing, security, and static runtime
features.routingNotes: Use platform for cross-cutting API, route guard, security, and publication behavior after excluding a more specific product branch.
verify: cd frontend && npm run lint && npm run build

sharedConcerns.label: Styles, themes, and responsive behavior
verify: cd frontend && npm run lint && npm run build
